name: Parivahan (Vahan & Sarathi)
description: National transport portal for vehicle registration (Vahan) and driving licence/learner licence (Sarathi) services.
eligibility: Vehicle owners and driving licence applicants as per Motor Vehicles Act.
benefits: Online RC, DL, permits, tax, slots; reduces RTO visits.
application_steps: Apply for RC/DL/LL with details and documents.
Pay fees and book RTO slot.
processing_time: RC/DL issued after RTO test/verification (days to weeks).
fees: As per state MV fee schedule; varies by service.
validity: RC 15 years (renewable); DL 20 years or till age 50/55/60 per class.

faq.q: Can I get my DL on DigiLocker?
faq.a: Yes, issued DL/RC can be fetched in DigiLocker.
Yes, for permanent DL after learner licence period.

ai_summary: Parivahan's Vahan/Sarathi offers online vehicle registration and driving licence services with RTO appointments.
ai_explanation: Parivahan is the national transport portal where citizens apply for vehicle registration, driving/learner licences, permits, and tax online, then visit the RTO for tests/verification. Issued documents sync to DigiLocker. Fees follow the state MV schedule.
